blocks.prose: Read this structure through Wealth, Property. Tai Yang in Wealth foregrounds outward contribution, visibility and mobilization, while Lian Zhen in Property adds boundary evaluation, value tension and selective engagement. The practical question is how “put resources into visible functions and collective use” can operate alongside “direct resources toward what passes value and boundary tests” in the same situation, rather than treating either symbol as a complete description of you.

blocks.prose: The constructive condition is visible contribution with sustainable limits. Under strain, the same function can appear as burnout, performative pressure or one-way giving. The surrounding Property context offers another condition to examine—clear standards with room for complexity—but it cannot be assumed to compensate if it instead becomes control struggles, moralization or reactive boundary shifts. Keep these conditional expressions distinct rather than collapsing them into a label of balance.

The constructive condition is visible contribution with sustainable limits. Under strain, the same function can appear as burnout, performative pressure or one-way giving. The surrounding Property context offers another condition to examine—clear standards with room for complexity—but it cannot be assumed to compensate if it instead becomes control struggles, moralization or reactive boundary shifts. Keep these conditional expressions distinct rather than collapsing them into a label of balance.
